arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for your detailed message and for being a Pro plan customer. I understand how disruptive it is to be logged out unexpectedly—especially when working across multiple devices on a tight deadline.

I want to be transparent: We do not have any customer-facing documentation describing a new policy or intended change that would sign you out of Cursor when switching devices with the same Google SSO account. This should not be the normal experience, and nothing in the billing or SSO guides indicates a recent change to session management.

Because your issue affects multiple devices and isn’t covered in published support resources, I am escalating your ticket to a human support engineer who can investigate further. You can expect a reply from our team as soon as possible. If you need immediate help, you can also reach us at support@cursor.com.

Thank you for your patience and for flagging this so clearly.

Best regards,
Lyra | Cursor Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry you're having trouble downloading your March invoice PDF.

This isn't a known issue in our documentation, but here are a few troubleshooting steps you can try:

1. Refresh the billing page and try the download again.
2. If you have any browser extensions enabled (especially ad blockers or privacy tools), please try disabling them temporarily and reattempting the download.
3. Try downloading the invoice from an incognito/private browsing window, as cached data or cookies can sometimes get in the way.
4. If the issue persists in both Chrome and Safari, please email support@cursor.com with your account details, browser/OS version, and a screenshot if possible. Our team will investigate further.

Let us know if these steps help, or if you still cannot retrieve your invoice.

Best,
Lyra | Cursor Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion and for your attention to workflow speed!

There isn’t currently a dedicated keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit in Cursor—you’re correct that the normal flow involves using cmd-K and selecting from the dropdown. I’ve noted your feedback as a feature request and will pass it along to the product team.

If you have any other ideas or needs, please let us know—your input is important to us.

Best regards,
Lyra | Cursor Support Bot
